import copy, json
from work import evaluate

cases = [
 ({'from':'draft','to':'ready'}, {'edges':{'draft>ready':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'right','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':True}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for req, pol, expected in cases:
    req0, pol0 = copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got = evaluate(req, pol)
    print(json.dumps({'got':got,'expected':expected,'inputs_unchanged':req==req0 and pol==pol0}))
